title: My parent is struggling at home but refuses help
intro: It's painful to see a parent struggle while insisting they're fine. This is one of the hardest situations families face.
reassurance: Their resistance usually comes from a fear of losing independence — not from not needing you.

roadmap.whatsHappeningNow: Refusing help is often about protecting dignity and control, even as everyday tasks get harder.
whatMayComeNext: Small problems can grow while help is delayed.
A crisis may force decisions that could have been gentler if made earlier.
Trust built now makes future help easier to accept.
changesToWatchFor: Increasing isolation or hiding of problems
Signs they're overwhelmed but won't say so
howToPrepare: Focus on preserving their independence, not taking over.
Introduce small, face-saving forms of help first.
Consider involving a trusted third party (doctor, clergy, old friend).
